representative_scale.selection: Fixed scale specified by brief. No scale search, extrapolation or doubling.

inputs.driver: Extract exact dhfr_ensemble.py fenced code from intake/brief.md.

timing_scope.primary: perf_counter around sequential replica loop, after PDB loading, force-field system construction and platform lookup; includes context creation, any context JIT compilation, position/velocity initialization, stepping, energy queries, Python aggregation and context destruction.
timing_scope.per_replica: Starts after context and position/velocity initialization; includes stepping and 100 energy queries through summary append.
excluded: PDB parsing and system construction before ensemble timer
JSON file writing and stdout after timer
timing_scope.method_comparison: Compare same fixed ensemble on one GPU and declare equivalent whole-ensemble timing boundaries; concurrent process launch and MPS setup timing policy is not specified by brief.

scientific_checks: Eight unique replica indices 0 through 7 with seeds 1000 through 1007 and 25000 steps each
Report mean and final potential energy per replica against corresponding sequential run
scoring_interface.reason: No published fixed-work energy acceptance tolerance or CUDA reference values. Null-tolerance throughput reference does not establish acceptance.
scoring_interface.concurrent_method_command_reason: Brief proposes MPS concurrency but does not supply fixed-work concurrent driver or command; do not substitute published fixed-time benchmark for fixed-work workload.

budgets.runtime_evidence: Brief estimates roughly one minute on H100 and a few minutes on slower GPUs; estimates unverified. Fixed finite 200000 aggregate integration steps; no adaptive scale loop.
budgets.reason: No workload run; setup, JIT, MPS and actual GPU wall times unknown.
